Run topology-dispatched rules

Source: R/topology_engine.R
run_rules.Rd

Unified rule runner for topology-driven rules. Rules are dispatched based on topology (A0-A7) and receive the smallest relevant payload plus full context.

Usage

run_rules(context, rules)

Arguments

context

A RuleContext or current ArtifactSnapshot.

rules

List of CoreRule objects.

Value

A data.frame of findings with metadata columns (RULE_ID, RULE_TITLE, TOPOLOGY, SCOPE, INTENT, SEVERITY, OWNER_TEAM).

Details

run_rules() dispatches each CoreRule by rule@topology and passes the smallest payload needed by that topology:

  • A0: fn(domain, context, rule) for domain-scoped rules, or fn(context, rule) for context-only rules.

  • A1, A2: fn(data, context, rule) where data is the current domain data.frame.

  • A3, A4: fn(domains, context, rule) where domains is a named list of current-cut data.frames.

  • A5, A6: fn(previous, current, context, rule) where previous and current are same-domain data.frames across cuts.

  • A7: fn(previous, current, context, rule) where both previous and current are named lists of data.frames across cuts.

If required domains are unavailable for a rule topology, the rule is skipped and contributes no rows.
